lines.say: Spot the mistake in this revision week.
Calculus, calculus, calculus. Linear algebra hasn't come back since October.
So what's wrong? A, too much calculus. B, no rest day. C, the topic that never comes back.
C. A topic that never comes back fades long before January.
Offload brings each flashcard back right before you'd forget it, so the old topics keep coming back.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
